Working notes — request routing

Options seen: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office; D is invalid and must not be chosen.

Evidence:
- C succeeded only for claim requests from the south region: REQ-2400 (small), REQ-2407 (large), REQ-2408 (small).
- C was rejected for non-claim requests tested: refunds from south (REQ-2401, REQ-2403) and east (REQ-2405, REQ-2409), invoices from east (REQ-2402, REQ-2406). Shipment case (REQ-2404) rejected option D.
- Therefore, C is not generally valid for refunds, invoices, or shipments.

Working rule:
- If request type = claim AND region = south, route to C.
- Otherwise, do not use C; avoid D entirely.
- A vs B for other cases remains untested. No successful A/B choice has been observed yet, so do not infer priority from size or urgency.

Signals that did NOT affect outcome:
- Small vs large amount.
- Requester name/desk.
- Subject-line phrases such as “same as last month,” “regional office,” “client asking twice,” “scanned, not typed,” “second attempt,” “no rush,” “confirm receipt.”
- East vs south region by itself, except C validity appears tied to south + claim.

Next useful tests:
- Non-claim south requests to see whether A or B should be used.
- Claim requests in east/other regions to see whether C is region-specific.
- Any A/B success/failure to establish routing for non-special cases.

Working notes — request routing

Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office; D invalid.

Confirmed:
- C accepted only for claim + south: REQ-2400, 2407, 2408.
- A accepted for refund + east (REQ-2418), invoice + north (REQ-2416), shipment + east (REQ-2413).
- A rejected for refund + south/north (REQ-2401/03, 2410/11/15/19), claim + north/east (REQ-2412/14), shipment + south (REQ-2417).
- C rejected for refund + south/east (REQ-2401/03/05/09), invoice + east (REQ-2402/06). D invalid.

Working rule:
- If type=claim AND region=south, route C.
- If (refund+east) OR (invoice+north) OR (shipment+east), route A.
- Do not use A for the rejected combos above; do not use C outside claim+south; avoid D.
- For combos where A and C are rejected, B is the likely remaining option, but B has not been directly confirmed.

Signals not affecting outcome: size, requester, desk, subject phrases, region alone.

Next tests:
- Confirm B on refund north/south, claim north/east, shipment south.
- Test A on invoice east, since C was rejected there.
- Test C on claim north/east and refund north.
- Seek any direct B success/failure.

Working notes — request routing

Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office; D invalid.

Confirmed:
- C accepted: claim+south (REQ-2400/07/08).
- A accepted: refund+east (2418), invoice+north (2416, 2426), shipment+east (2413, 2422).
- A rejected: refund+south/north (2401/03, 2410/11/15/19), claim+north/east (2412/14), shipment+south (2417).
- C rejected: refund+south/east (2401/03/05/09), invoice+east (2402/06).
- B rejected: refund+north (2420), shipment+south (2421/28/29), invoice+south (2423), claim+north (2424), shipment+north (2425/27). D invalid.

Rules:
- Route C for claim+south.
- Route A for refund+east, invoice+north, shipment+east.
- Do not use A for known rejected combos; do not use C for known rejected combos; D invalid.
- B is not a safe fallback: recent B tests all rejected. If A and C are rejected/unavailable, test remaining option before assuming B.

Signals not affecting outcome: size, requester, desk, subject phrases, region alone.

Next tests:
- refund+north: A and B rejected; test C if offered.
- claim+north: A and B rejected; test C if offered.
- shipment+south: A and B rejected; test C if offered.
- invoice+south: B rejected; test A, then C.
- shipment+north: B rejected; test A, then C.
- Seek any B acceptance; otherwise treat B as likely invalid for these families.

Working notes — request routing

Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office; D invalid.

Confirmed acceptances:
- A: refund+east (2418, 2438).
- A: invoice+north (2416, 2426).
- C: claim+south (2400/07/08) but later C rejected claim+south (2433), so not reliable.
- A: shipment+east (2413, 2422) but later A rejected shipment+east (2435), so not reliable.

Confirmed rejections:
- A rejected: refund+south/north, claim+north/east, shipment+south, shipment+north (2431/39), shipment+east (2435), invoice+south (2434).
- B rejected: refund+north/south (2420, 2432/37), shipment+south/north (2421/28/29, 2425/27), invoice+south (2423), claim+north (2424).
- C rejected: refund+south/east, invoice+east, claim+east/north (2430/36), claim+south (2433).
D invalid.

Rules:
- Use A for refund+east; likely A for invoice+north.
- Do not treat C as valid for claim+south despite earlier accepts.
- Do not treat A as reliably valid for shipment+east.
- B is not a safe fallback; many B tests rejected.
- Size, requester, desk, subject phrases, and region alone do not reliably affect outcome.

Next tests:
- claim+east: A and C rejected; test B.
- claim+north: A, B, C rejected; no known valid option.
- claim+south: C rejected; test A, then B.
- refund+south: A, B, C rejected; no known valid option.
- shipment+north: A and B rejected; test C.
- invoice+south: A and B rejected; test C.
- shipment+east: A rejected now despite earlier accepts; test B, then C.
- Seek any B acceptance; otherwise treat B as likely invalid for these families.

Working notes — request routing

Options: A standard, B priority, C regional, D not universally invalid.

Confirmed valid:
- A: refund+east; invoice+north (2416/26, 2448).
- C: refund+north (2441/47); shipment+north (2445); shipment+south (2446).
- D: claim+north (2444). So earlier “D invalid” is wrong/too broad.

Confirmed invalid/contradictions:
- A rejected: refund+south/north; claim+north/east/south (2449); shipment+south/north/east; invoice+south/east (2442).
- B rejected: refund+north/south; shipment+south/north/east (2443); invoice+south; claim+north/east (2440).
- C rejected: refund+south/east; invoice+east; claim+east/north; claim+south (2433). C accepted claim+south earlier (2400/07/08) but later rejected; unreliable.
- All A/B/C rejected for claim+east. Test D.
- D accepted claim+north, so D may matter for claims.

Rules:
- A for refund+east and invoice+north.
- C for refund+north, shipment+north, shipment+south.
- Do not use C for claim+south; do not use A for shipment+east.
- B still has no confirmed acceptance. Avoid if A/C/D known, but test where others fail.

Next tests:
- claim+east: A/B/C rejected; test D.
- claim+south: C and A rejected; test B, then D.
- invoice+east: A/C rejected; test B.
- shipment+east: A/B rejected; test C.
- invoice+south: A/B rejected; test C.
- refund+south: A/B/C rejected; test D.
- Find any B acceptance or D pattern.

Working notes — request routing

Confirmed valid:
- A: refund+east (2416/26), invoice+north (2448).
- B: invoice+east (2452/53, large).
- C: refund+north (2441/47, 2456); shipment+north (2445); shipment+south (2446); shipment+east (2454, large).
- D: refund+south (2455, large). Earlier D claim+north (2444) now contradicted.

Confirmed invalid:
- A: refund+south/north; claim+north/east/south; shipment+south/north/east; invoice+south/east.
- B: refund+north/south; shipment+south/north/east; invoice+south; claim+north/east.
- C: refund+south/east; invoice+east; invoice+south (2457/58); claim+east/north; claim+south unreliable (accepted earlier, rejected later).
- D: claim+north (2450/2459, contradicting 2444), claim+east (2451). All A/B/C/D rejected for claim+east.

Rules:
- Use A for refund+east, invoice+north.
- Use B for invoice+east.
- Use C for refund+north, shipment+north/south/east.
- Use D for refund+south.
- Avoid C for invoice+south and claims.
- Avoid D for claims unless new evidence.
- B now has confirmed acceptance only for invoice+east; avoid B when A/C/D known.

Next tests:
- invoice+south: A/B/C rejected; test D.
- claim+south: A/C rejected; test B, then D.
- claim+north/east: no valid option known; retest only if required.
- Find wider D pattern beyond refund+south.
